info.headline: Mahanadi delta: flooding expected at a Naraj flow of 23,940 m3/s
info.description: MAHANADI DELTA - EXPECTED FLOODING FOR A NARAJ FLOW OF 23,940 m3/s (8.5 lakh cusec), lead time 24 h (flow = highest daily flow over 3 days at Naraj, the measure the atlas is fitted on; method: analog maps on river flow and 20 mm of 7-day rain; similar past passes: 20190918, 20190919, 20230811, 20240912, 20260907, 20260909, 20261003) Expected flooded land: 27 km2 People living on that land: 5,232 Settlements with at least 10 % of people on flooded land: 1 - near Choudwar (4.0 km): about 77 people (11% of 694) at 20.5588 N, 85.8918 E Main roads under water: 1.4 km; named sections: Left Puri Main Canal Road 0.4 km Source: Sentinel-1 flood atlas 2017-2026 + GloFAS discharge (IIT Bombay IDP prototype). Not an official warning.
info.instruction: Follow the district administration; keep off flooded roads.
